caption: I'm quietly waiting, and I hear Jake ask, "Why 23?" Then I see Nicous touch his head, and Jake continues, "15 plus 6 plus 2 plus 1, right?" Lucia then says, "Ah, let me check again." Choiszt is playing the guitar. I see Choiszt nod and then gesture a bit. I turn my head and look towards the living room, then back to my room, and then I look at Choiszt again. I smile briefly. I then look towards the living room again, and I see Lucia walk in. I look towards the living room once more. Then I look toward the living room again. Jake then states, "You've used 40G on the card." Finally, I look at my room.

the scene unfolds at a dining table where preparations are underway for a meal. I hear Lucia questioning, "Ah, are you sure?" and suggesting there might only be baking ingredients. Shure insists, "No, that big bowl is sesame paste," clarifying it's the sesame paste they prepared. Lucia agrees to take another look. My gaze then shifts to a plate of food as Tasha wonders, "Oh, did you bring it with you? It does have a bit of..." I hear Alice asking, "Is it clean?" I briefly pick up a pair of glasses and then set them back down. I then slightly push the dish on the table. Finally, after hearing "Almost done" from Alice, I put on the glasses.

I am at the dining table, where we are having hot pot. I took an oil bottle from Lucia's hand, questioning, "Are you sure?" because "I feel like there are only some baking ingredients there." I then placed the oil bottle on the table. I said, "No, that big bowl is the sesame sauce." Subsequently, I grabbed another bottle, this one containing vinegar, and positioned it on the table. Lucia then commented, "Ah, I'll go take another look." To this, I responded, "Yeah, that bowl is the sesame sauce I prepared." Afterwards, I turned my head to look at the tablet positioned on the table and tapped the screen again. Tasha asked, "Ah, just bring this one?" Then, I turned my head to glance at Alice. "It might be a bit..." said Tasha and then turned my head to look at the tablet again. I moved my face a bit as I continued watching a live stream on the tablet.

I am in a room with Shure and Tasha, and I turn to my right, observing Shure looking at the computer screen. I turn back left, stating, "Ah, are you sure? I feel like that area only has some baking ingredients." I then place the soy sauce next to Tasha. I turn right again, overhearing Shure's response: "No, that big bowl is just sesame paste." I respond with, "Ah, okay, let me take another look," followed by Shure's confirmation, "Yeah, that bowl is the sesame paste I prepared." After the conversation, I proceed to walk towards the door of the room, then descend the stairs. I make a turn and adjust my glasses before entering the living room on the first floor. I then walk from the living room into the kitchen, where Jake informs me: "You've already used 40GB."

I began by pointing towards the kitchen area as I engaged in a conversation, responding to Lucia's query with, "Ah, are you sure?" I then looked down at a tablet in my hands, replying to her statement about the kitchen containing mostly baking ingredients. I slid my finger across the tablet screen. I raised my hand slightly, then looked towards the group of people I was talking to. I confirmed, "No, that big bowl is sesame paste." Lucia then responded, "Ah, okay, I'll take another look." I elaborated, "Yeah, that bowl has the sesame paste I prepared." I then retracted my right hand and continued sliding my finger across the tablet's screen. Tasha then asked, "Ah, are we just bringing this? It might be a bit much." I continued sliding my finger across the tablet. Then, I transitioned to selecting a movie to watch later and opened the search box on the tablet.
